title: Minecraft Has Sold 350 Million Copies, More Than America Has People

scenes.text: Minecraft has sold 350 million copies, more than America has people.
Mojang reported the number in its annual report in 2025.
Guinness World Records lists it as the best selling video game ever.
That's more copies than the population of the United States.
A game built from blocks, bigger than a country.

description:
